modules.title: 一句中英混合的短句怎样被切成 Token
文字怎样变成模型处理的片段

items.title: 文字按规则切成片段
items.text: “帮我改 login 按钮”会按模型规则切成若干文字、符号或代码片段。英文通常一词一 Token，中文一字约 1.5 到 2 个 Token。

items.title: 逐片生成，输入输出都计费
items.text: 模型读取输入片段，并一个片段接一个片段地生成回答。送进去的提示词和模型吐出的回答都会计入用量。

items.title: 精简文件保护预算与回答质量
items.text: 一个网页源码约 2000-5000 Token；若让 AI 一次读完整目录可能消耗数万 Token。只发送相关文件能节省成本并避免信息稀释。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 一个汉字不保证就是一个 Token；准确数量要按具体模型的切分规则计算。

lessonPractice.title: 团队按“一个汉字等于一个 Token”估算上下文和费用，实际账单总是对不上。应该怎样估算？

options.label: 按所用模型的实际分词和用量统计输入、输出与相关上下文
options.feedback: Token 划分随模型和内容变化，真实用量或对应分词工具比字符数规则可靠。

options.label: 继续按每个汉字、字母和标点各算一个 Token
options.feedback: 字符与 Token 不是固定一一对应，代码、中文和英文都可能被不同方式切分。

options.label: 只统计 AI 最终回答，系统规则、历史和文件都不计入
options.feedback: 模型读取的输入同样占用上下文和用量，不能只看屏幕上新增的回答。

en.title: A team estimates context and cost with one Chinese character equals one token, but bills never match. How should usage be estimated?

options.label: Use the selected model's tokenizer or actual usage for input, output, and included context
options.feedback: Tokenization varies by model and content, so actual usage or the matching tokenizer is more reliable than character rules.

options.label: Keep counting each character, letter, and punctuation mark as one token
options.feedback: Characters and tokens are not one-to-one; code, Chinese, and English may all split differently.

options.label: Count only the final AI answer and ignore system rules, history, and files
options.feedback: Input read by the model also consumes context and usage, not only newly displayed output.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请按当前模型统计这次请求的输入、输出和缓存 Token，输入要包含系统规则、对话历史、文件与工具结果。不要用字符数直接换算；同时告诉我上下文占用和费用估算依据。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Report input, output, and cached tokens for the current model, including system rules, history, files, and tool results in input. Do not convert directly from character count; explain context usage and the cost basis.

learning.assumes: You have seen a chat input and a long answer.
learning.outcome: You can recognize a token as a model-specific text piece rather than a fixed word or character.

modules.title: How a mixed-language sentence becomes tokens
How text becomes pieces a model processes

items.title: Split into rule-based pieces
items.text: The model breaks sentences into tokens using its tokenizer. English is roughly 1 token per word; Chinese is around 1.5–2 tokens per character.

items.title: Generated piecewise, counted both ways
items.text: It reads input pieces and generates output pieces one at a time. Both your prompt and the generated response count toward token usage.

items.title: Keep files relevant to protect quality and budget
items.text: A webpage's source is roughly 2,000–5,000 tokens. Sending only relevant files instead of entire projects saves cost and avoids diluting model focus.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: One Chinese character is not guaranteed to be one token. Use the target model’s tokenizer for an exact count.
